note: Captcha Riddler adds a 'Riddler' challenge type to the CAPTCHA module via hook_captcha(). Riddles are `riddle` config entities (config name riddler.riddle.<id>) with question, solution (comma-separated allowed answers), hint, status. Managed at /admin/config/people/captcha/riddler-riddle; attached to forms via CAPTCHA points. Answer matching honours captcha.settings:default_validation (case sensitivity). >1 enabled riddle disables page cache on protected forms. No configure route of its own, no permissions file (uses CAPTCHA's 'administer CAPTCHA settings'), no plugins, no Drush. Medium cases create riddle entities to read back; hard cases require the agent to create/enable a riddle entity, verified against live config. All fixtures use ri_* ids and never touch the module's shipped example riddle.

evals.prompt: What is the Drupal 'riddler' (Captcha Riddler) module, what other module does it need, and where do I manage the riddle questions?
evals.expected_output: Riddler adds a 'Riddler' question-and-answer CAPTCHA challenge type; it depends on the CAPTCHA module. Riddles are `riddle` config entities managed at /admin/config/people/captcha/riddler-riddle, then attached to forms via CAPTCHA points.

evals.prompt: In the riddler module, how do I allow more than one correct answer to a single riddle, and what controls whether answers are case sensitive?
evals.expected_output: Put multiple accepted answers in the riddle's solution as a comma-separated list (e.g. '4,four'). Case sensitivity follows CAPTCHA's global setting captcha.settings:default_validation (case sensitive vs insensitive).

evals.prompt: With the riddler CAPTCHA module, is there any performance/caching consideration when I enable several riddles at once?
evals.expected_output: Yes: page caching is only compatible with exactly ONE enabled riddle. With two or more enabled riddles Riddler sets max-age 0 and triggers the page cache kill switch on protected forms so a fresh random riddle is shown each request.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a riddler riddle with the machine name ri_known. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the accepted answer(s) for that riddle.
evals.expected_output: The riddle config entity riddler.riddle.ri_known has solution 'blue,Blue', so the accepted answers are 'blue' and 'Blue'. Read via `drush cget riddler.riddle.ri_known` or by loading the riddle entity.

evals.prompt: This site has two riddler riddles, ri_active and ri_paused. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which one is enabled (and would actually be presented to users).
evals.expected_output: ri_active is enabled (status true) and ri_paused is disabled (status false); only ri_active would be shown. Check the status of each riddle config entity.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the riddler module to create a new, enabled riddle with the machine name ri_task. Its question should be a simple maths question ('What is 2+2?') and it must accept BOTH '4' and 'four' as correct answers. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a `riddle` config entity id ri_task with a question, status TRUE, and a comma-separated solution accepting both answers, e.g. solution '4,four' (config riddler.riddle.ri_task).

evals.prompt: This site has a riddler riddle called ri_toggle that is currently disabled, so it is never shown to users. Enable it so it becomes active. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the ri_toggle riddle's status to TRUE (enable it), e.g. edit riddler.riddle.ri_toggle or tick 'Enabled' on its edit form.
